honesty: Every parameter is an ESTIMATE: {low, central, high, unit, source, vintage, assumed}. Products of three or four bands make a wide band on purpose. Negotiation-planning ranges, not quotes.

rate_anchor_usd_per_km.source: tralac, "Transportation costs and efficiency in West and Central Africa" (https://www.tralac.org/discussions/article/9364-transportation-costs-and-efficiency-in-west-and-central-africa.html), figure and 1.5 to 2.2x multiple as stated in the KCC build brief. NOT re-verified in this build: a web search did not surface the figure and the page fetch was blocked.
rate_anchor_usd_per_km.vintage: not confirmed (cited as tralac / World Bank WCA corridor evidence)

sa_us_multiple.unit: x South Africa / US per-km cost
sa_us_multiple.source: same as anchor (build brief); verified: false

rate_band_multiplier.source: KCC analyst assumption: Nigeria sits inside the WCA average but corridors differ; the spread is a stated judgement, not measured

anchor_applies_to: one loaded truck-km on a container/articulated truck; the commodity payload turns truck-km into tonne-km (assumption: container-truck km and commodity-truck km cost the same before the vehicle factor)

winding_factor.source: derived from this build's own OSRM table: 10th percentile / median / 90th percentile of road km over Haversine km, 430 routed pairs over 30 km

routed_distance_band.source: KCC analyst assumption: free OSRM profile ignores road quality, ferries and detours around insecurity

min_effective_km.source: KCC analyst assumption: very short hauls still cost a minimum trip (waiting, positioning)

niger_delta_feeder.source: KCC analyst assumption: creek, security and checkpoint friction when both ends are Niger Delta states and the leg is under 250 km

port_hinterland.source: KCC analyst assumption: port-gate queues and tanker/truck call-up systems when either end is a port

north_long_haul.source: KCC analyst assumption: insecurity and escort costs when either end is in a northern zone

inland_default.source: KCC analyst assumption: baseline for all other legs

corridor_factor.rule: the class with the highest central factor that applies is used (one class per quote)

South South.source: KCC analyst assumption (PROXY): no measured road-condition data in the bundle; wet-zone road wear

road_condition_proxy.rule: worse of the two endpoint zones by central value; labelled a proxy, never a measurement

fx_ngn_per_usd.source: PLACEHOLDER reference rate chosen by KCC. No FX feed is bundled and none was checked in this build. Press reports in 2026 cite rates near 1,600 (unverified). Override with ?fx=

rounding: USD figures are rounded to the nearest USD 1 per tonne (and to 2 decimals per km) so a band is never shown with false precision
